newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish energy consortium buys 53 pct Gas Nat ESP.
newsitem.headline: Spanish energy consortium buys 53 pct Gas Nat ESP.

text.p: MADRID, June 6 (reuter) - Spanish energy group Repsol confirmed on Friday it had bought together with Iberdrola and Gas Natural de Espana a 53 percent stake in Bogota's biggest natural gas distributor, Gas Natural ESP, for $148 million.
Repsol Chairman Alfonso Cortina told a shareholders meeting in Madrid: "I can announce that Repsol, Gas Natural and Iberdrola have bought 53 percent of Bogota's gas distributor for $148 million".
Colombia's state oil company Ecopetrol said on Thursday it had sold its 53.7 percent stake in the gas distributor for 19,322 pesos per share.

By the end of last year, Gas Natural ESP had about 330,000 customers in the metropolitan area of Bogota. There is enormous potential growth in gas consumption in Colombia and the company forecasts it will be supplying up to one million households by the year 2000.
Cortina said Repsol's investment in Latin America since July 1996 had totalled more than one billion dollars, without taking into account the $330 million invested in June 1996 in Venezuela.
Spanish energy firm Repsol intends to invest some 370 billion pesetas in the next five years in Latin America.
